family: Yamaha K-Line research (MT / YZF / XSR / Tracer)
display_name: Yamaha K-Line research placeholder (MT / YZF / XSR / Tracer)
notes: Common Yamaha models (MT-03/07/09/10, YZF-R6/R1, XSR700/900, Tracer 700/900, MT-125). Evidence recovered so far is a passive MT-03 660 dashboard-stream observation (one source-captured 6-byte frame shape, synthetic tests only), source-reported MT-03 K-Line streams (smiddelkoop/yamaha-kline-ubuntu, captured status bytes are not stored fault codes), and offline Yamaha MT image checksum research (NetworkDir/moto-ecu-checksum: MT-25 2019, MT-07 2014-16/2020/2021, MT-09 SP 2019; a checksum match is not a signature, fitment or flash authorization). No Yamaha diagnostic initialization, addressing, request or scaling definition was recovered, so this is an unknown zero-capability placeholder and physical use is blocked. The offline checksum and dashboard-stream tools in the web workstation remain available. 2026-11-03 capture search: passive 500 kbps CAN broadcast captures and a CC BY 4.0 DBC exist for the Yamaha R9 2026 (DeziderMesko/motocan, acdb146) and an MIT MT-07 2014 decoder (JackHat1/MT07_CAN_Project, fec86c3); both are broadcast-only with no tester-transmitted diagnostic session, so they improve offline decoding only and do not change this placeholder's blocked physical status.

kline.note: K-Line hardware is suggested by source-reported streams, but baud rate, initialization, addressing and application framing are not claimed without a model-specific public definition or capture.

session.physical_blocked_reason: Only passive stream observations and offline checksum research exist; no family-specific initialization transcript or primary diagnostic wire definition was recovered.

memory.write_blocked_reason: Offline checksum research on listed MT images does not establish a memory-access sequence, complete backup geometry or any programming authorization; this build refuses the operation.
